availability.reason: host byte-source route for asset import is not registered

resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal; no document, glyph or pixel payload in either direction.

semantics: Attach one embedded image to, or remove one from, the project asset catalog. Attach names a file source; the host (never the page, never MCP-supplied bytes) reads the bytes and the one native owner admits them: typed container check, charged decode, SHA-256 content identity and de-duplication. An exact duplicate is applied=false with no revision, history or redo change. A new asset id is minted by the owner as asset-<requestId>; the receipt does not echo it. Remove refuses a non-image record and an asset a placement, item or the viewport reference still names. Unavailable until the host byte-source route is registered by its owner; until then every caller receives typed unavailability and no fallback writer exists.
